hostname.description: Host for the gateway. Leave empty ('') for wildcard/IP+NodePort access, or set a hostname: a dotted FQDN (kubeflow.example.com), a single-label name (kubeflow, localhost), or an IPv4 literal (10.43.1.7) are all accepted. Must not contain '*' — a literal wildcard hostname would make the auth-bypass filter trust every host on an internet-facing named listener. A bare public suffix (a single-label registry TLD such as 'com'/'io') is ALSO rejected: hostname seeds the letsEncrypt ClusterIssuer's DNS-01 dnsZones, so a bare TLD would scope the ACME solver to the entire TLD. The list is the common gTLD/ccTLD set, not the full Public Suffix List. The DNS charset is enforced (no whitespace, non-breaking space, embedded newlines, trailing dot, leading '-', or '_'): the hostname is embedded verbatim into the authn EnvoyFilter's Lua, and an invalid character makes LuaJIT reject the inline_code, so istiod NACKs the whole filter and the gateway falls open (no auth). Rejecting it here fails the install instead. Independent of TLS. Kept in sync with the umbrella values.schema.json.

gatewayAuthMode.description: Ingress-gateway authentication mode. 'native' (default): upstream-parity Istio-native ext_authz — istiod MeshConfig extensionProvider + CUSTOM AuthorizationPolicy + dex-jwt RequestAuthentication + require-jwt DENY. 'envoyfilter': self-contained hand-written EnvoyFilter ext_authz chain (for BYO-istio). Kept in sync with the umbrella values.schema.json.

istio.description: Istio ingress-gateway identity — single source of truth (umbrella parent overrides). Kept in sync with the umbrella values.schema.json.

principal.description: ServiceAccount principal of the ingress gateway used by AuthorizationPolicy source.principals. Rancher/AppCo Istio: 'cluster.local/ns/istio-system/sa/istio'; upstream: '.../sa/istio-ingressgateway-service-account'.

selector.description: Workload label selector of the ingress-gateway pods, shared by the Gateway CRs, the authn EnvoyFilter workloadSelector, and the native auth CRs. Must be non-empty: an empty selector on the istio-system auth resources (context: GATEWAY) would attach the auth chain to every gateway in the mesh. Rancher: {istio: istio}; upstream: {istio: ingressgateway}.

kserveDomain.description: Base domain for the KServe wildcard cert/listener. Must be a bare FQDN with no leading '*.' — the chart forms '*.<kserveDomain>' itself, so a value like '*.example.com' would produce a '*.*.example.com' host (unissuable, and a malformed listener). Kept in sync with the umbrella values.schema.json constraint.

name.description: Dedicated KServe/Knative inference gateway (namespace/name). This sub-chart renders a Gateway CR of this name/namespace; kept in sync with the umbrella global.kserveGateway.name (parent overrides). Default 'kubeflow/kserve-ingress-gateway'.
